svg.title: A message enters the shared cache
svg.desc: Keep the previous topology fixed. Highlight only the writer-to-cache path and the stored row, while other workload connections remain neutral; writing is not yet proof of every reader receiving it. Use the independent shared package-cache namespace geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.
